AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&6502786168&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: _plannerRefBridge
                /* Publish the real toolbar + main sceneView so the planner's embedded*/
                /* editor (MainView) can bind a non-null toolbar and isolate pen input.*/
                /* Bare `toolbar`/`sceneView` resolve here (DocumentView.qml file scope);*/
                /* `navigator` resolves via the shared MainView id scope.*/
                function _publish() {
                    try { ~&254540341572282132&~.plToolbar = ~&233745975898428&~; } catch (~&180974&~) {}
                    try { ~&254540341572282132&~.plSceneView = ~&254547437090201330&~; } catch (e2) {}
                    try { ~&254540341572282132&~.plTools = ~&7842069035455457876&~; } catch (e3) {}
                }
                ~&254480451320573660&~.~&495334332051582499&~: { _plannerRefBridge._publish(); }
                ~&254480451320573660&~.~&4464585548018432538&~: {
                    try { ~&254540341572282132&~.plToolbar = ~&6504117156&~; } catch (~&180974&~) {}
                    try { ~&254540341572282132&~.plSceneView = ~&6504117156&~; } catch (e2) {}
                    try { ~&254540341572282132&~.plTools = ~&6504117156&~; } catch (e3) {}
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
